passages.title: Room request
passages.text:
To: Facilities Desk
From: Daniel Okafor, Purchasing Department
Subject: Room request for Thursday workshop
Date: May 6

Dear Facilities Team,

I am writing to request a larger room for the vendor workshop on Thursday, May 15. We originally booked Conference Room B, which seats twelve. However, 20 people have now confirmed their attendance, so we will need a room with at least 22 seats. We will also need a projector and two microphones.

If Conference Room A is free from 1:00 P.M. to 4:00 P.M., it would be ideal. Please reply by Friday so that I can update the invitations.

Thank you,
Daniel Okafor

questions.q: Why did Mr. Okafor write the e-mail?
options: To invite vendors to a meeting

why.vi: Câu đầu: "request a larger room". Workshop và thiết bị chỉ là chi tiết.
why.en: The first sentence states the purpose: a request for a larger room.

questions.trap: Email có nhắc projector và micro nhưng đó là yêu cầu phụ, không phải mục đích chính.

questions.q: How many seats does Conference Room B have?
questions.trap: 20 là số người xác nhận, 22 là số chỗ cần có, đều không phải sức chứa của phòng B.

questions.q: What does Mr. Okafor ask the Facilities Desk to do by Friday?

why.vi: "Please reply by Friday": anh ấy cần được trả lời.

questions.trap: "Update the invitations" là việc chính anh Okafor sẽ làm sau khi nhận được trả lời.

passages.title: Request for availability
passages.text:
To: All exhibit staff
From: Priya Nair, Visitor Services Manager
Subject: Request for availability during school-group week
Date: May 12

Dear colleagues,

Next month the aquarium will host school groups every weekday from June 9 to June 13. Because the groups arrive at 9:30 A.M., we need two additional keepers at the jellyfish exhibit during those mornings.

If you are willing to start early, please reply with the days you can work by Tuesday, May 27. Staff who volunteer will receive one extra paid day off, which can be taken any time before the end of August.

Please note that requests from staff who have not completed the group-safety training cannot be accepted. The training is available online until May 23.

Regards,
Priya Nair

questions.q: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
options: To explain a change in opening hours
To ask staff to volunteer for extra shifts
To report on a safety inspection

why.vi: Chị Nair cần thêm hai nhân viên, xin người "willing to start early" trả lời.
why.en: The manager needs two more keepers and asks willing staff to reply with their available days.

questions.trap: Có nhắc "safety training" nhưng đó là điều kiện, không phải chủ đề của email.

questions.q: By when should interested staff reply?

why.vi: "reply with the days you can work by Tuesday, May 27."

questions.trap: May 23 là hạn hoàn thành khóa đào tạo, June 9 là ngày nhóm học sinh đến.

questions.q: What is suggested about a keeper who has not finished the training by May 23?
options: He or she will be unable to join the extra shifts
He or she will be given a day off
He or she must take the training in person
He or she will lose a paid holiday

why.vi: Email nói đơn của người chưa học xong "cannot be accepted", nên người đó không thể nhận ca thêm.
why.en: Requests from staff without the training "cannot be accepted," so that keeper cannot work the extra shifts.

questions.trap: Đừng chọn "day off": ngày nghỉ là phần thưởng cho người tình nguyện, không liên quan đến việc thiếu đào tạo.
